problemSigns.detail: A spring breaking often sounds like a firecracker or gunshot.

problemSigns.sign: Door won't lift or feels extremely heavy
problemSigns.detail: Broken springs remove the counter-balance needed to lift the door manually or with an opener.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: A clear separation in the coiled spring indicates a break.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: This often means one spring has broken on a two-spring system, leaving insufficient lifting power.
Without proper spring tension, the cables can come off their drums or appear loose.
